description: The line plot illustrates the relationship between initial and final accuracy across different values of o_pop frequency, with the x-axis representing o_pop frequency scaled by 10^4 and ranging from 1 to 19, and the y-axis showing accuracy values from 0.0 to 1.0. The green line with square markers represents the initial accuracy, which starts at approximately 0.35, rises to a peak of about 0.5 at an o_pop frequency of 5, then declines to roughly 0.3 at a frequency of 7, increases again to about 0.45 at 13, and stabilizes around 0.4 for higher frequencies. The blue line with diamond markers represents the final accuracy, which begins at approximately 0.7, increases to a peak of about 0.9 at a frequency of 9, then fluctuates slightly, peaking again at 0.9 at 15, and ending at around 0.9 at 19. Both lines show error bars, indicating variability in the measurements. The final accuracy consistently remains higher than the initial accuracy across all measured frequencies.
